data.name: Returning Knives
data.description: When maintaining psionic focus, your thrown daggers and xephyr knives are treated as having the returning special ability.  In addition, you can expend your psionic focus when making a ranged attack with a dagger to use that same weapon for all attacks on your turn, rather than having to wait for the dagger to return.
